title: Merge the KWS transition-validation branch: campaign schema 1.1.0 stays with the m11 protocol, KWS high-BER format becomes 1.3.0
notes: Merged m12-kws-transition-validation into v2 (merge commit 8607bdb) by the owner's decision of 2026-11-17: campaign schema version 1.1.0 stays with the capability protocol; the KWS high-BER request format is now 1.3.0 (one request file and its test updated). Saved records are classified by protocol through netsurf.cross_pool.campaign_kind, so the high-BER campaign frozen on 2026-11-10 with schema 1.1.0 and the v1 protocol name still loads with its own primary comparison; record-consuming code now branches on the protocol instead of the version number. New tests in tests/test_cross_pool_schema_versions.py (9 cases). Verified: the seven saved campaigns of the four protocols load and classify correctly with the merged code; full suite on v2 gives 717 passed, 53 skipped, none failed. Branch retired with its archive tag; its folder and run outputs are untouched. Branches now: v2, master and the two Paper 1 working branches. Not pushed: v2 is 6 commits ahead of both remotes.
